item.futuretinker.wolf_armor.description: Armor built for a wolf: right-click a tamed wolf to put it on, shears take it off.
item.futuretinker.spear.description: Hold right-click to lower the spear: charge damage scales with the speed of you and your target, and a fast enough joust dismounts riders. Jabs reach 4.5 blocks and can hit several targets, but cannot hit inside 2 blocks.
item.futuretinker.spear_head.description: The head: its durability sets the spear's tier, which drives the charge multiplier and dismount threshold.
material.futuretinker.charge.description: How much of the charge damage comes from speed.
item.futuretinker.mace.description: The head sets the spikes: hard ones pierce armour, tough ones control, light ones hit fast. A moving target gets torn open.
item.futuretinker.mace_head.description: More hardness means more armour pierce and a narrower sweep; more toughness leans to control; both low means faster swings.
material.futuretinker.hardness.descripti: Drives armour piercing and how tight the sweep is, and slows the swing.
material.futuretinker.toughness.descript: Drives the control effect and the sweep angle.
